payload.abstract: Lobachevsky University Electrocardiography Database (LUDB) is an ECG signal database with marked boundaries and peaks of P, T waves and QRS complexes. The database consists of 200 10-second 12-lead ECG signal records representing different morphologies of the ECG signal. The ECGs were collected from healthy volunteers and patients of the Nizhny Novgorod City Hospital No 5 in 2017–2018. The patients had various cardiovascular diseases while some of them had pacemakers. The boundaries of P, T waves and QRS complexes were manually annotated by cardiologists for all 200 records. Also, each record is annotated with the corresponding diagnosis. The database can be used for educational purposes as well as for training and testing algorithms for ECG delineation, i.e. for automatic detection of boundaries and peaks of P, T waves and QRS complexes.
